pd_sisters_1.summary: Andrey dismisses a visitor, then stretches and drifts into his room.
Masha confides her disappointment with her marriage and coarse civilians to Vershinin.
Vershinin laments Russian life and unburdens his miserable marriage to Masha.
Masha hears the oven noise and admits she is superstitious.
Vershinin declares his love; Masha laughs, afraid, then lets him continue.
Masha breaks off as Irina and Tuzenbach enter, Tuzenbach courting her.

s01082.summary: Barnaby rehearses his pirate speech to an empty clubhouse while Odalys teases him.
A noisy family arrives and Barnaby greets them grandly as Odalys undercuts him.
Barnaby's hat lands on a child, and they hand out putters amid squawks.

s01097.summary: After a narrow loss, Toby blames Rags for calling the hammer too late.
Rags slams her glass and insists the ice told her when.
Rags softens, praises the team, and they toast the ninth end together.

s01111.summary: Five friends hide in the dark waiting to surprise the birthday girl.
Keys scrape repeatedly at the lock as everyone freezes and hushes Tibby.
A pizza delivery man opens the door and the group ambushes him with chaos.
Frosting-covered Tibby learns it is the wrong apartment and claims the pizza.

s00013.summary: Silas mourns his shot horse on the salt flats as Connie approaches.
Connie offers water for a name; Silas wryly refuses the trade.
Silas steps closer and Connie reaches for her rifle in a standoff.
Silas presses Connie about Dutch Halloran and warns of his approaching gang.
Connie shares water and both reveal Halloran destroyed their lives.
Connie lays out an ambush using the brine vats; Silas takes her bullets.
Dust rises on the ridge and they head for the vats together.

s01023.summary: Paulina halts the cannery line for a break while the crew relaxes.
Desmond shows Gus a video of his niece, earning a real smile.
Taps come from the live tank; Paulina questions Desmond, who blames pipes.
Gus notes the water is still, and the tapping comes from inside.
Paulina approaches the tank and finds a pale hand pressed to the glass.
Gus's drowned face floats up while the seated Gus smiles too wide; lights die.

s01088.summary: Bee and limping Bram haul the unconscious captain across the mangrove mud.
Bee checks the captain's pulse as Bram warns the tide is turning.
Bee forces Bram to abandon their water to carry the captain.
Bram falls and begs to be left; Bee hauls him up refusing.
The captain wakes, insists on crawling himself, and they follow him.

s01105.summary: Fionnuala scopes enemies from a bombed cinema roof beside wounded Ikenna.
Tavakoli's noise makes Fionnuala flinch; Ikenna calms her down.
The old projectionist shows the silent beams leading to safety.
Ikenna crawls off; Fionnuala orders Tavakoli to follow while she stays.
The men reach the beams and Fionnuala rises to take aim.

s01039.summary: Strangers in a late-night laundromat trade tips and talk about the snow.
Elderly Walter shuffles in needing change, and Nadia gives him quarters.
Walter reveals his wife died and he never learned to do laundry.
The strangers reassure Walter, and Tucker invites him to sit with them.

s01112.summary: Nadia calls a rest stop on the glacier despite Nat's urgency.
They share a thermos and Nadia points out the distant pass.
Injured Desmond insists he can walk; Nat ties him in as anchor.
The three haul the sled silently toward the pass into the wind.

s01118.summary: Gwendolyn reads the lighthouse logs and spots an entry by a dead man.
Holding the page to the flame reveals a hidden line: He did not fall.
The harbormaster reports Pellew's empty boat, yet the lamp burned all night.
A floorboard creaks overhead and Gwendolyn pockets the log and climbs.

s01069.summary: A man and nervous Nina prepare to dispose of a sedan, watched by a kid.
Eli refuses to crush the car without papers, citing Terrence's rule.
The man looms over Eli, who calmly holds his ground.
The man grabs Eli; a brawl erupts and all three tumble in gravel.
Eli triggers the crusher, which swallows the sedan and the cash bag.

pd_sisters_2.summary: Tuzenbach proposes a charity concert featuring Masha; Kuligin worries about the Director.
Vershinin reports the brigade may be transferred, saddening everyone.
Chebutikin drops the mother's clock, which shatters, and rambles nihilistically.
Chebutikin blurts out Natasha's affair with Protopopov and exits singing.
Vershinin recounts his frightened daughters during the fire and philosophizes on the future.

pd_earnest_1.summary: Jack tests whether Gwendolen could love him without the name Ernest.
Jack urges marriage; Gwendolen insists he propose properly first.
Jack kneels and proposes; Gwendolen accepts while critiquing his technique.
Lady Bracknell enters and orders Jack up from his knees.
Lady Bracknell denies the engagement and banishes Gwendolen to the carriage.

s01037.summary: Sunny slips into Roz's table late, and Roz introduces her to Trevor.
Roz lays out the rotating vault heist and assigns everyone's roles.
Sunny haggles over her cut and teases Roz.
Roz explains the pneumatic tube, her sister, and the sleepy guards.
Trevor and Sunny probe the plan's weaknesses; Roz parries each one.
Trevor admires the view; Roz dismisses it, and they toast.

s00017.summary: Gloria shouts greetings from the balloon as terrified Winnie clings on.
Gloria notices a worrying dial, covers it, and hands Winnie responsibility for the burner.

s01071.summary: Adelaide stands stiffly in Tobias's workshop, needling him about the dusty shop.
The boy's shout prompts Adelaide to probe about his mother, wounding Tobias.
Tobias offers tea and asks her to remove gloves; she nearly does.
They acknowledge the burned letter's message without saying it aloud.
Adelaide asks him to light a lamp for her and leaves; he cleans the lamp.

s00005.summary: Sabine outlines the casino vault plan as the funicular climbs.
Nervous Teo raises worries; Sabine deflects with a joke.
The man in gray gives his name, Halvard, as the summit nears.

s01117.summary: Felix asks Babcia why his mother left; she freezes, then stirs on.
Babcia insists he eat first and serves porridge, smoothing his hair.
Babcia explains his mother wanted a different life, but this one isn't bad.
Felix asks if she'll return; Babcia holds his hand and speaks of swallows.

s00006.summary: Merchants on a giant tortoise's shell brace as it slows to listen.
Dominic grumbles about lost lanterns and trades insults with Isolde.
The shell groans and lurches as Maeve orders everyone to the rails.

s01050.summary: Odalys sits in a car wash in her funeral dress, remembering her husband.
She rests her head on the wheel, laughs, stops, then drives out.

s01114.summary: Exhausted Anselmo ignores urgent pages on a hospital stairwell break.
Anselmo tallies his burdens and reflects that a doctor carries a weight limit.
Anselmo pulls himself together, answers the page, and climbs back up.

s01073.summary: Opposing lawyers Nadia and Eli bicker at the loading dock.
Nadia opens a box revealing an uninventoried water-stained ledger.
The judge arrives and Eli and Nadia accuse each other of tampering.
Eli lunges for the ledger, boxes topple, and Deputy Hale bursts in.
The judge calmly stands Hale down and seizes the ledger for chambers.
Eli fears the judge; Nadia notes she's deciding who wins.
